Production AI Agent 参考架构

这是对一次受控 Agent Runtime 的放大图。它把 Context 构建、Model 推理、Capability 执行、Host 侧 Policy、Validation 与 Production Control Plane 分开，避免把 LLM 本身误认为完整 Agent 系统。

ENTRYUser / Application → Request / Identity / Session在推理开始前先确定 current goal、tenant、role、permission、risk level 与 task/session boundary。
CONTEXT PLANE · CH 02–07Context Builder只组装当前一步真正需要的上下文：system instructions、conversation / working state、long-term memory、retrieved evidence 与 available capabilities。
RAG / SEARCH / DBMEMORY / STATESKILLS / TOOLS
REASONING LOOP · CH 08Model / Reasoner理解当前状态，决定或规划下一步，然后提出 response 或 action。Model 负责 propose，不直接拥有真实副作用。
DIRECT RESPONSEACTION REQUEST
TOOL RESULT ↺ UPDATE STATE ↺ CONTINUE / STOP
ACTION PLANE · CH 06 / 08 / 09Capability → Policy → Host先路由到 Skill / capability，再检查 permission、risk、approval，经 MCP / function interface，最终由 Host 执行真实 Tool 或 Service。
APIDATABASESERVICE
COMPLETION GATEValidate / Policy / HITL → Response / Side Effect / ArtifactSchema、evidence、business rule、authorization、safety、artifact check 与 human approval 共同证明 proposed completion 是否能成为真实输出或副作用。
CONTROL PLANE · CH 09Trace · Eval · Safety · Cost · Latency · Release · MonitoringControl Plane 负责测量和治理 Runtime，而不是替代 Runtime 本身；它为 release、rollback、diagnosis 与 cost-per-successful-task 提供证据。
PRODUCTION LEARNING LOOPFeedback / Trace → Root Cause / Dataset → Build / Test → Next VersionProduction evidence 只有经过 filter、failure attribution、curation，并回流成可复现 test 或 engineering change，才真正成为 learning asset。
Agent ≠ LLMAgent = Model + Context + State + Memory + Retrieval + Skills/Tools + Runtime/Orchestration + Policy/Permissions + Validation + Observability

en:
Production AI Agent Reference Architecture

This is the zoom-in view of one controlled Agent runtime. It separates context construction, model reasoning, capability execution, host-side policy, validation, and the production control plane so that the LLM is never confused with the whole Agent system.

ENTRYUser / Application → Request / Identity / SessionEstablish the current goal, tenant, role, permissions, risk level, and task/session boundary before reasoning starts.
CONTEXT PLANE · CH 02–07Context BuilderAssemble only the context needed for this step: system instructions, conversation and working state, long-term memory, retrieved evidence, and available capabilities.
RAG / SEARCH / DBMEMORY / STATESKILLS / TOOLS
REASONING LOOP · CH 08Model / ReasonerUnderstand the current state, decide or plan the next step, then propose either a response or an action. The model proposes; it does not directly own side effects.
DIRECT RESPONSEACTION REQUEST
TOOL RESULT ↺ UPDATE STATE ↺ CONTINUE / STOP
ACTION PLANE · CH 06 / 08 / 09Capability → Policy → HostRoute to a Skill or capability, check permission/risk/approval, cross the MCP or function interface, then let the host execute the real tool or service.
APIDATABASESERVICE
COMPLETION GATEValidate / Policy / HITL → Response / Side Effect / ArtifactSchema, evidence, business rule, authorization, safety, artifact checks, and human approval prove whether the proposed completion may become a real output or side effect.
CONTROL PLANE · CH 09Trace · Eval · Safety · Cost · Latency · Release · MonitoringThe control plane measures and governs the runtime without pretending to be the runtime itself. It provides evidence for release, rollback, diagnosis, and cost-per-successful-task decisions.
PRODUCTION LEARNING LOOPFeedback / Trace → Root Cause / Dataset → Build / Test → Next VersionProduction evidence becomes a learning asset only after it is filtered, attributed, curated, and routed back into reproducible tests or engineering changes.
Agent ≠ LLMAgent = Model + Context + State + Memory + Retrieval + Skills/Tools + Runtime/Orchestration + Policy/Permissions + Validation + Observability
